title: 斩获Anthropic 2.5亿美元巨额订单！AI芯片黑马Fractile估值暴增6倍冲击65亿美元
content:
A new major player emerges in the AI chip field with a large-scale fundraising. The AI chip startup Fractile is currently raising about 600 million dollars with a pre-money valuation of 6.5 billion dollars. According to sources, Fractile had a valuation of around 1 billion dollars when it concluded its previous fundraising in May this year, but the current valuation has surged more than sixfold in just a few months.
The sharp increase in the company's valuation was driven by securing a significant business contract. Fractile has signed a fundamental partnership agreement with Anthropic and will sell about 250 million dollars worth of AI chips to the latter. The two companies plan to further expand their collaboration. Based on the current progress, the relevant chips are expected to be officially launched in 2027.
Fractile, established in 2022, is an innovative company specializing in the research and development of AI inference chips. The company's core technology aims to significantly reduce the time required for artificial intelligence to generate answers or solve complex problems, and it is attempting to open up a new competitive route in the AI chip market, which was previously dominated by Intel and Nvidia.

report.summary: AI芯片新秀Fractile获Anthropic 2.5亿美元订单，估值暴涨6倍至65亿美元。
report.background: Fractile成立于2022年，专注AI推理芯片研发，旨在大幅缩短AI生成答案或解决复杂问题的时间。此前AI芯片市场由英伟达和英特尔主导，Fractile试图开辟新路线。今年5月其估值约10亿美元，近期因与Anthropic签署约2.5亿美元的芯片采购协议，估值数月内飙升至65亿美元。双方计划继续扩大合作，相关芯片预计2027年正式推出。
key_points: Fractile正在进行约6亿美元融资，投前估值达65亿美元，较5月增长超6倍。
公司与Anthropic签署基础合作协议，将出售约2.5亿美元AI推理芯片，并计划深化合作。
Fractile核心技术聚焦推理加速，目标是减少AI生成答案或解决复杂问题所需时间。
该订单验证了推理芯片市场的需求，挑战英伟达和英特尔在AI芯片领域的传统主导地位。
合作芯片预计2027年量产落地，显示长期战略布局而非短期炒作。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，这标志着推理专用芯片成为新战场，可能降低对英伟达训练芯片的依赖，推动算力成本下降。对开发者，未来可能获得更高效、低延迟的推理硬件，优化AI应用响应速度。对普通用户，AI助手、搜索等服务的体验将更流畅，但需等到2027年才能看到实际产品落地。
report.tools: 关注推理优化开源项目：vLLM（高吞吐LLM推理）、TensorRT-LLM（NVIDIA推理加速）、MLC-LLM（跨平台部署）。若跟进Fractile动态，可关注其技术论文或与Anthropic合作进展。
